task: RSCH-014 B8: bounded BUG-087 enemy-rate ownership and allocation audit

scope.purpose: Determine whether B7 rate design has a demonstrated code and state owner on the integrated baseline without changing fixed module limits, loader/MMU protocol, renderer, audio, or adaptive-clock ownership.

source_identity.production_diff_from_a29: No changes in src, scripts, or tiled between a29a2b7 and e6b67aa.
source_identity.source_revision_evidence: The current enemy fixed boundary is authored at $17A0 in src/main.s and src/enemy_runtime.s. B7 fit evidence used a reconstructed E2 fixture; it did not retain exact candidate source, listing, map, binary, or failure log.

b7_evidence.fit_fixture: Reconstructed BUG086/E2 overlay; not an exact retained complete build.

b7_generator.disposition: Not run. It is a reconstructed candidate generator, not an exact reproducibility artifact.

fixed_enemy_code.owner: Fixed low-RAM enemy module, ending before the fixed object-mask LUT at $17A0.
fixed_enemy_code.historical_b7_capacity: The B7 E2 fit recorded 55 bytes free before $17A0; its compact candidate failed that boundary by 143 bytes.
fixed_enemy_code.qualification: The -143 assembler output has no retained source/listing/map/binary/log, and the reconstructed generator was not rerun. The candidate also omitted the required $61B7 saturation behavior. Treat -143 as a historical optimistic lower-bound blocker, not an exact current integrated fit.
fixed_enemy_code.minimum_capacity_prerequisite: At least 143 additional bytes must be recovered before $17A0 merely to fit the historical unsaturated compact candidate. Required saturation and any interface/call bytes add an unmeasured amount. The exact viable total cannot be derived from retained artifacts.
fixed_enemy_code.decision: No demonstrated fixed-owner fit. Do not raise or move the $17A0 LUT boundary.

bug086_page34_helper.decision: Cannot hold the 143-byte historical overflow; do not treat reserved logo bytes as capacity.

bug058_b2_banked_helper.decision: No rate code or state allocation here; preserve adaptive ownership and its fixed vector layout.

post_boot_low_ram.boot_lifetime: The 99-byte GMC descriptor table starts at $0287 and retires at boot_streams_retired before audio initialization.
post_boot_low_ram.mapping: Ordinary unbanked low RAM, outside direct page. Absolute extended accesses and their extra code/cycle cost must be included.
post_boot_low_ram.audit_limit: A source operand scan found no executable/data references to $029B-$02BF; src/audio_runtime.s:987 mentions $02BF only in a comment about the boot-table end. This does not prove absence of indirect accesses, retained pointers, or generated references; no ownership allocation is approved.
post_boot_low_ram.assessment: Plausible phase-independent state candidate, not a proven owner.

name_entry_direct_page_alias.current_owners: $DF name row, $E0 column, $E1 repeat/phase, $E2 direction/flags, $E3 owner, $E4-$E5 pointer.
name_entry_direct_page_alias.evidence: Existing $E1 alias is explicitly phase-guarded for menu redraw/name repeat. Main skips enemy_tick during initial entry and enters the normal enemy path only after presentation returns zero.
name_entry_direct_page_alias.audit_limit: Complete name-entry, demo, all-profile and transition retirement/reinitialization proof is absent. The range remains occupied and cannot be called free.

possible_separate_code_extent.map_status: memory-map.html marks $A3B0-$A3EF and $A3F0-$A46F as free game-state ranges. ENEMY_TABLE begins at $A470.
possible_separate_code_extent.source_relationship: This lies after ENTITY_TABLE at $A380-$A3AF and before ENEMY_TABLE. No B8 proof of every clear/writer, profile overlay or maximum-entity bound was performed.
possible_separate_code_extent.transport_relationship: GMC bootstrap already supports generic sparse segments and assigns PAR5 page destinations. BUG086 has an existing page-$34 delivery pattern, but no BUG087 code segment or call mapping is retained.
possible_separate_code_extent.assessment: A candidate for the next bounded ownership audit only. Splitting executable code here would create a new runtime owner and needs exact source split, caller mapping, loader-copy fit, lifecycle proof, and approval before repair execution.

other_extent_rejected.reason: Although listed as free game-state growth in the map, presentation_runtime.s uses $A590 as PRES_CURSOR_SAVE_A. Do not assign persistent rate state or code without a distinct lifecycle alias proof.

lifecycle_contract.intended_rate_state_reset: Only true game/stage initialization (init_game_state and next_stage); next_stage calls init_enemy and increments STAGE, skipping zero by incrementing again.
lifecycle_contract.spawn: Newly released roaming enemies join the current shared stage-rate phase; spawn/release must not reset it.
lifecycle_contract.death: enemy_tick_impl calls reset_enemy_state on death start; that per-enemy reset must not reset shared stage-rate state.
lifecycle_contract.blocked_or_frozen: enemy movement is gated by FREEZE_TIMER and LAST_FRAME parity. Whether rate credit is discarded or retained while movement is blocked/frozen is unresolved and cannot be inferred from current code.
lifecycle_contract.initial_entry: main_game_tick runs initial_entry_tick without enemy_tick while INITIAL_ENTRY_STATE is active.
lifecycle_contract.stage_wrap: CoCo next_stage skips stage zero; arcade source elapsed counter wraps to zero. Mapping and saturation behavior at this boundary remain unresolved.
lifecycle_contract.clock_separation: Do not reuse BOX_TIMER, ENEMY_TIMER/ENEMY_ANIM, player cadence, LAST_FRAME, or adaptive debt as the rate owner.
lifecycle_contract.fidelity_gate: Arcade-to-CoCo movement-dispatch and elapsed-timer conversion remains unmeasured; blocked/frozen due-credit behavior and later-part conversion also remain open.

decision.result: No current fit claim. Existing fixed, BUG086 helper, and B2 helper capacity is insufficient or already owned. A3B0-A46F is a plausible but unproven separate-code extent.
decision.why_no_build: The compact candidate is not retained/reproducible, required saturation is absent, and a separate code owner/lifecycle/call mapping is not yet proven. A full build would not discriminate a concrete selected design.
decision.why_not_perf005: PERF-005 covers the AD0 joystick resident overflow; that resident budget does not create bytes before the fixed $17A0 enemy LUT or prove a page-$34 owner.
decision.ticket_status: BUG-087 remains Draft; this evidence does not approve implementation or change acceptance criteria.
decision.next_discriminator: Bounded proof of every writer/clear/overlay and maximum table extent for $A3B0-$A46F, followed only if clean by an isolated exact code-split fit that includes saturation and extended-state/call overhead. Otherwise report the exact blocked ownership boundary.
excluded: No production or canonical wiki edit
No renderer, audio, adaptive clock, MMU, loader protocol, fixed-boundary or user TMX change
